verdict.rationale: BVNK's API supports programmatic wallet creation (per-customer wallets) secured by Hawk auth, and a probe surfaces an 'agent-wallet-cli' repo suggesting some agent-specific tooling exists, but there is no documentation of scoped/limited API keys, policy engines, or explicit spend limits governing what an agent can move. Missing for 10: scoped key issuance for agents, policy/permission controls, documented transfer limits, and any first-party description of the agent-wallet-cli's capabilities.
